newsitem.title: PERU: Peru says first-half tax revenues rise 5.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Peru says first-half tax revenues rise 5.4 pct.

text.p: Peru's first-half tax revenues totalled 11.553 billion soles ($4.34 billion), up 5.4 percent in real terms from the same period last year, the National Superintendency of Tax Administration (SUNAT) said on Friday.
The higher revenues were due to "the growth of the economy at rates above forecasts," SUNAT said in a statement.
Tax revenues rose 4.9 percent in real terms during 1996 to 19.94 billion soles.
